summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend smoke testing of OKA Bau digital ecosystem. Backend: 45/45 pytest tests PASSED (100%) covering health/meta/cms/portfolio, auth (register/login all 3 seeded roles, /auth/me, password-reset flows, role change ADMIN only), public request→lead (consent 422, success 201 with 'Vielen Dank' message, employee 403), CRM (lead patch, convert produces OKA-2026-XXXX project + system chat + temp_password + client login, 2nd convert 409, /client/dashboard shows active project), projects (client/employee/other-client role scoping, 3D model null, stage/progress + stage_history, zones CRUD + 422 for invalid status, timeline, updates client_visible filter, tasks status, diary hidden from client), commerce (offer totals 1500/285/1785 with 19% VAT, DRAFT 403 for client, SENT→VIEWED on client GET, accept ACCEPTED + 2nd 409, PDF %PDF magic, invoice from offer_id copies items, PAID, PDF), comms (messages POST/GET on /api/projects/{pid}/messages endpoint, other-client 403, inbox, appointment type validation 422, notifications list), admin (dashboard/employee-dashboard/analytics/activity contains LOGIN+LEAD_CONVERTED+OFFER_ACCEPTED, search, settings GET/PUT, cms PUT ADMIN only 403 for employee, employees POST, customers CRUD, portfolio POST, email-outbox), files (documents upload with category='Plan' 201, DELETE soft-delete, media list). Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844 — home renders hero-3d (WebGL working), 'Räume.' headline, bottom tabs Home/Leistungen/Projekte/Mein Projekt/Kontakt visible, /anfrage form loads with fields, /mein-projekt shows login form with login-email/password/submit testIDs, login as kunde@example.com works and shows 'Guten Tag, Test' + Kundenportal 'Noch keine aktiven Projekte' state as expected (that user has no project). No red screens, no page errors. Deprecated three.js warnings (Clock, PCFSoftShadowMap) come from react-three-fiber internals — non-blocking. No deprecated Expo packages found (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'THREE.Clock deprecated, use THREE.Timer' and 'THREE.WebGLShadowMap PCFSoftShadowMap removed'. Source is inside three/react-three-fiber; non-blocking. Consider pinning compatible versions.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely from a UI library; verify source and migrate to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: investigate three.js/react-three-fiber deprecation warnings and pointerEvents prop warning to keep console clean.
critical_code_review_comments: commerce.py: GET /invoices side-effect mutation (auto-OVERDUE) writes on read — acceptable but note this modifies state on GET; consider a background task instead.
auth.py /auth/session: Uses external Emergent OAuth endpoint; not testable in this environment (expected).
projects.py update_project: EMPLOYEE allowed keys limited to progress/client_notes — correct; ensure UI reflects this.
files.py DOC_CATEGORIES uses German title-case ('Plan','Angebot',...); frontend must send exact strings — flagged only as a coordination note.
seed_data_creation: Each test class creates its own fresh lead via POST /api/public/request and converts to project via POST /api/leads/{id}/convert (session fixture `converted`). Also creates TEST-prefixed customers, employees, portfolio items, tasks, updates, diary entries, offers, invoices. No production data mutated (only settings PUT overwrites 'company_tagline' → 'TEST'; CMS homepage_hero headline overwritten to 'TEST' — main agent may want to reseed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. pytest.ini uses xdist loadscope with -n 2, so fixtures are per-class per-worker (each class-level test gets its own converted lead/project). Use `converted` fixture from conftest for any test needing a client+project+customer trio. Frontend testIDs verified: hero-3d, login-email, login-password, login-submit. Client 'kunde@example.com' has no project by design; use the temp_password from lead conversion to test client portal flows against a real active project. Object storage endpoints work (documents upload returned 201).
